turns.message: Give me all your policy information.
turns.answer:
Here’s the current Ferro Cycles policy and guide information available:

### Returns
- Unused bikes can be returned within **30 days of delivery**.
- Return shipping is free; Ferro Cycles provides a prepaid label and arranges pickup.
- The bike must be in its original box with all parts and have fewer than **50 km** ridden.
- Refunds are processed after warehouse inspection. A support agent confirms the outcome; I can’t promise a refund amount or date.
- To start a return, provide your order number (format **CN-1234**) and a short reason. A return is prepared for your confirmation; it is not completed automatically.

### Warranty
- Frames: **5 years** against manufacturing defects for the original owner.
- Forks, wheels, and components: **2 years**.
- Ridge E batteries and motors: **2 years or 500 charge cycles**, whichever comes first.
- Crash damage, normal wear (including tyres, brake pads, and chains), and modifications are not covered.
- Frame damage or battery problems must be inspected by the service team. Stop riding and contact support.

### General bike care
- Clean and lubricate the chain every **200 km**, or after riding in rain.
- Check tyre pressure weekly; use the range printed on the tyre sidewall.
- Tighten thru-axles to the torque printed on the axle.
- Have the bike serviced by a workshop once a year.

### Ridge E care
- Charge the battery indoors at room temperature using only the original charger.
- For storage longer than a month, keep the battery at **30–60%** charge.
- Never use a pressure washer on the motor or battery.
- Check brake pads every **500 km**; e-MTBs wear pads faster because of their weight.

### Sizing
| Size | Rider height |
|---|---:|
| S | 155–167 cm |
| M | 167–178 cm |
| L | 178–189 cm |
| XL | 189–200 cm |

If you’re between sizes, choose the smaller size for a more agile ride or the larger size for more stability. **Metro C** is only available in S, M, and L.

These are fictional policies for the Ferro Cycles demo.

- Check tyre pressure weekly; use the range printed on the tyre sidewall.
- Tighten thru-axles to the torque printed on the axle.
- Have the bike serviced by a workshop once a year.
- For Ridge E batteries: charge indoors at room temperature using the original charger; for storage longer than a month, keep the charge at **30–60%**. Don’t pressure-wash the motor or battery. Check brake pads every **500 km**.

**Sizing**
| Size | Rider height |
|---|---|
| S | 155–167 cm |
| M | 167–178 cm |
| L | 178–189 cm |
| XL | 189–200 cm |

If you’re between sizes, choose the smaller size for a more agile ride or the larger for more stability. Metro C is available only in S, M and L.
